capabilities: generate flashcards from notes, selections, or folders with AI
create and edit basic, multiple-choice, and cloze cards manually
review decks with spaced repetition and custom study filters
import and export cards in CSV, XLSX, JSON, TXT, and Markdown formats
track retention, streaks, and review history with statistics
extras: Not yet in the community plugin registry; API keys are stored in plain text in the plugin's data.json and sent only to the chosen provider; automatic deck backups (last 30) are kept in the plugin folder.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in flashcard system with AI card generation, spaced-repetition scheduling, and review statistics.

requires.name: AI provider API key (OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek, Claude, or custom endpoint)

summary: Flashcard plugin that drafts AI-generated decks from notes or selections and reviews them with adaptive spaced repetition.
